title: Medical Officer & Clinical Officer — KIM Medical Plaza
summary: KIM Medical Plaza in Abim Town, Karamoja Region, is seeking qualified and dedicated Medical Officer and Clinical Officer professionals to join its team on full-time, contract-based employment.
description:
KIM Medical Plaza, located in Abim Town Council, is seeking qualified and dedicated professionals to join our team on a full-time basis.

Available Positions:
- Medical Officer — 1 position
- Clinical Officer — 1 position

Work Location:
Abim Town, Karamoja Region

Employment Type:
Formal contract, full-time

Benefits:
- Salary negotiable (Medical Officer: UGX 1.5M, Clinical Officer: UGX 600K)
- Weekly allowance

Minimum Qualifications:
- Valid practising licence, up to date
- Strong organisational and communication skills

Only candidates who meet the above qualifications should apply.
how_to_apply:
Only candidates who meet the above qualifications should submit their CV and other relevant documents via WhatsApp to 0704948185.

Important: Do not pay any money for this job connection. KIM Medical Plaza does not charge applicants at any stage of the recruitment process.
